provenance.paper_title: DreamFactory: Pioneering Multi-Scene Long Video Generation with a Multi-Agent Framework

representation_paths.memory_component: Long- and short-term visual memory of generated scenes/frames

evidence.section: Full paper: Algorithm 2 Calculate CSSC Score
evidence.paraphrase: Image vector-DB entries; Base-frame references. New scenes are conditioned on retrieved reference frames; Monitor agent checks the new scene against stored frames.

evidence.section: Full paper: Keyframe Iteration Design Method leverages
evidence.paraphrase: Short-term memory turns over and the Monitor agent re-conditions scenes; a fixed monitoring rule. For DreamFactory, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of Long- and short-term visual memory of generated scenes/frames.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (Long- and short-term visual memory of generated scenes/frames) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
